name: rouh.land account
title: Your rouh.land account: whether this Rouh is connected to one and what is wrong between them if anything is (on Your Rouh), and the person's own rouh.land account, what it keeps and what is done only there (on You, Your account)

permissions: reads what this Rouh keeps about its registration on rouh.land (its birth row)

asks rouh.land how this Rouh's keys stand as an administrator opens the page, at most once in five minutes, and again when they press Try again beside an error (the same ask as the gene log's beat makes every six hours)
accounts: the owner's account on rouh.land, once this Rouh is connected there
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/landaccount.py, rouh/web/landaccount.py and its routes, landaccountpage.js and landaccountpage.css, the landAccountBody box in the account section of rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, its line in app/runs.js's settingsPages, and the rouh.land lines birthpage.js draws on Your Rouh from /api/rouh-land/account. Your Rouh then shows only what /api/birth says.
